svg.aria-label: Fifteen focus and research areas — Hafiz Muhammed A H, 0xtor.exe

g.text: 01 / OFFENSIVE SECURITY — WEB & NETWORK
Web application and network security assessments, including black-box SaaS.
External and internal VAPT scoping, reporting and testing across infrastructure and production servers.
WEB · NETWORK · VAPT · BURP SUITE · NMAP · WIRESHARK · SCAPY
02 / REVERSE ENGINEERING & BINARY EXPLOITATION
Understanding software internals, program behaviour and binary structure beneath the visible interface.
Debugging and analysing compiled targets to study execution flow, memory and attack surfaces.
RADARE2 · GDB · PEDA · ASSEMBLY · DEBUGGING · BINARY ANALYSIS
03 / MALWARE ANALYSIS
Studying malicious software as both a defensive discipline and a reverse-engineering problem.
Examining behaviour, monitoring execution and exploring side-channel signals for detection.
STATIC & DYNAMIC ANALYSIS · BEHAVIOUR · SIDE-CHANNEL · DETECTION
04 / MOBILE & ANDROID SECURITY
Android application security testing across APK analysis, runtime instrumentation and static inspection.
Building an emulator-based lab to trace, hook and analyse mobile applications.
JADX · FRIDA · MOBSF · ANDROID EMULATOR · ADB · APK ANALYSIS
05 / AUTOMOTIVE CYBERSECURITY
Studying in-vehicle networks and vehicle trust boundaries, from CAN frames to diagnostic services.
Mapping the attack surface — ECUs, buses, infotainment and external interfaces.
CAN BUS · UDS · J1939 · LIN · AUTOMOTIVE ETHERNET · CANDUMP · SAVVYCAN
06 / EMBEDDED & HARDWARE SECURITY
Reverse engineering embedded firmware and examining hardware attack surfaces beyond software-only labs.
Exploring fault injection, side-channel analysis and the security of exposed physical interfaces.
ESP32 · FIRMWARE RE · FAULT INJECTION · SIDE-CHANNEL · UART · GPIO
07 / RF & SOFTWARE-DEFINED RADIO
Learning signals, modulation and spectrum analysis through software-defined radio tooling.
Working from signal-identification resources toward practical RF capture and inspection.
GNU RADIO · SDR# · SDR++ · SDRANGEL · SIGIDWIKI · SPECTRUM ANALYSIS
08 / AEROSPACE & SATELLITE SECURITY
Studying the security of communication links, sensing, navigation and control in aerospace platforms.
Exploring nanosatellite attack surfaces, SATCOM and the security implications of systems such as Starlink.
SATCOM · NANOSAT · GNSS · SPACE SYSTEMS · LINK SECURITY
09 / ELECTRONIC WARFARE & SIGINT
Building a structured foundation in signals intelligence and electronic warfare from the fundamentals up.
Studying COMINT, ELINT, radar and the radio-frequency systems behind sensing and electronic attack.
SIGINT · COMINT · ELINT · EW · RADAR · SPECTRUM · SDR
10 / AI & AGENT SECURITY
Researching attacks against autonomous agents, including prompt and guidance injection.
Mapping AI threats to MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS and studying how tool integration expands the attack surface.
LLM SECURITY · AGENT ATTACKS · PROMPT INJECTION · MITRE ATLAS · ATT&CK
11 / IOT, OT & ICS SECURITY
Examining connected devices, smart hubs and shared or rented hardware for real-world weaknesses.
Studying operational-technology and industrial control systems, from PLCs to industrial protocols.
IOT · SMART HUBS · PLC · SIEMENS S7 · UMAS · PCCC · OT / ICS
12 / CYBER-PHYSICAL & MARITIME SECURITY
Mapping security across systems that bridge software, hardware and physical operation.
Exploring maritime systems such as AIS, GNSS, ECDIS, VDR, radar and satellite links.
MARITIME · AIS · GNSS SPOOFING · ECDIS · VDR · VSAT · GMDSS
13 / VULNERABILITY RESEARCH & BUG BOUNTY
Working toward vulnerability research and bug-bounty practice beyond automated scanning.
Focusing on attack surfaces, trust boundaries, protocols and implementation flaws.
VULN RESEARCH · BUG BOUNTY · THREAT MODELLING · ATTACK SURFACE
14 / CTF & CERTIFICATION TRAINING
Hands-on training through Hack The Box machines and capture-the-flag challenges.
Studying Underpass and LinkVortex, the CTF Apocalypse 2025, and preparing for CPENT AI.
HTB · CTF · CPENT AI · CEH · LINUX · PRIVILEGE ESCALATION
15 / LABS & RESEARCH ENVIRONMENT
A maintained virtualised research lab on Kali Linux, with Windows hosts and emulator-based mobile testing.
Troubleshooting kernels, guest additions, shared folders and containerised security tooling as everyday work.
KALI LINUX · VIRTUALBOX / VMWARE · WSL · DOCKER · PWNDOC · HASHCAT
